text.en: Atlas core-muscle design study, 12 October 2026. Metres, Y up, body left +X, body front +Z. Nine region muscle parts; PEEL displacement 0.065 m; source stature 1.7095 m. Cameras, illustrative trunk/hip angles and contraction signals are teaching design values.
text.zh: Atlas 腰腹肌肉设计研究，2026 年 10 月 12 日。单位米，Y 向上，身体左侧 +X、正面 +Z；9 个区内肌肉零件，剥层位移 0.065 米，源模型身高 1.7095 米。镜头、示意关节角和收缩信号均为教学设计值。

note.en: Geometry and attachment review derive from scripts/anatomy/core. Trunk motion uses one teaching pivot, not individual lumbar vertebrae; muscle signals do not measure force or EMG.
note.zh: 几何及附着审查来自 scripts/anatomy/core；躯干用一个教学支点，不逐节活动腰椎；肌肉信号不是力量或肌电测量。

text.en: McGill S. M. Core training: evidence translating to better performance and injury prevention. Strength and Conditioning Journal 32(3): 33–46, 2010. doi:10.1519/SSC.0b013e3181df4521.
text.zh: McGill S. M.《核心训练：转化为更好表现与伤害预防的证据》，Strength and Conditioning Journal 32(3): 33–46，2010 年。doi:10.1519/SSC.0b013e3181df4521。

note.en: Abstract read (publisher page paywalled; abstract text read in an indexed reproduction, 12 October 2026). The abstract states that in many real-life activities the core muscles stiffen the torso and function primarily to prevent motion, unlike limb muscles that create motion. Used only for that role of the core; the review's exercise progressions, performance and injury-prevention claims are not adopted. Some reference lists give the pages as 33–47.
note.zh: 只读到摘要（出版社页面需付费；2026 年 10 月 12 日在索引转载中读到摘要原文）。摘要指出：在许多日常活动中，核心肌肉让躯干变得稳固，主要作用是阻止运动，这与产生运动的四肢肌肉不同。本主题只引用这一点；文中的训练进阶、运动表现与伤害预防主张未采用。部分文献目录把页码写作 33–47。
